goal: Give all Longcycle role instances one simple ChatGPT-chat operating path: GitHub Connect for exact remote state and S-to-H writes, remote CI for executable validation, model memory for isolated blind probes, and the proven private ChatGPT/Google Drive round-trip for cursor-required database artifacts.
baseline_impact: none; this removes an invalid local-Agent assumption and projects existing CAP-0006/CAP-0009/CAP-0010 rules into the actual chat runtime without changing Evidence, PIT/no-lookahead, Reality/Judgment/Outcome, provenance, seal immutability, reservation ownership, or database-generation authority
schema_impact: documentation and current governance metadata only; no product schema, migration, capability card, worker reservation/cursor, research artifact, Drive object, or database generation change
acceptance: The manual and all three prompts assume one runtime only: ChatGPT chat, GitHub Connect for every repository operation, exact remote CI for executable checks, and no local git/worktree requirement.

Startup reads exact main/worker heads, reservation, cursor and hot pointers through GitHub Connect, compares checkpoint-to-head paths, and conservatively derives CLEAN, RECOVERY_REQUIRED, BLOCKED or AUDIT_ASSISTANCE_REQUIRED.

GitHub writes always name the owned branch, run sequentially, preserve append-only raw/receipt paths, never force-update, treat the final substantive commit as S, and follow with a cursor-only H verified by exact remote comparison and CI.
The current Banking and Shipping blind Memory probes remain executable without general web or Drive and cannot promote model recall into Evidence, Reality, Outcome or seal.
Database restore occurs only when required_for_current_task is true and follows the proven exact Drive file-id/revision/size/SHA path into a private read-only ChatGPT sandbox copy.

Upload follows the initial-Agent transaction unchanged: close/hash, push and acknowledge intent, upload a new immutable private Drive object, capture identity, download back by id, verify hash/size/openability, push outcome with download_back_verified, then H.

Intent-without-outcome recovery inspects Drive before retry; Drive filenames/list order never define identity, objects are never overwritten, workers never share a writable database, and only global_serial promotes the Git generation head.
A chat session missing Drive reports CAPABILITY_BLOCKED_DRIVE only when its current cursor actually requires a binary object; it does not create a new governance role or move large bytes into GitHub.

The sequence-130 genuine Fresh-Agent drill remains the scheduled global bootstrap/history-recall sample; it does not claim to validate each worker cursor and cannot replace role-level startup continuity audits.

Every new or returning worker instance independently audits its exact remote reservation, cursor, pointers, delta and CI before work; a context-free role-adoption drill is added only for a new role contract or a material shared worker-protocol change, not for every temporary Agent or handoff generation.
No L3/L4 decision is introduced; runtime/tool availability remains an L2 routing fact.
